data.name: The Manhattan at Times Square
data.hotelDescription:
Central Manhattan Location
The Manhattan at Times Square is perfectly situated in the heart of Manhattan, just steps away from iconic landmarks like Times Square and Rockefeller Centre.

Comfortable Accommodations
Each room at The Manhattan at Times Square is equipped with a work desk, and select rooms boast stunning skyline views and a cozy seating area for relaxation.

Convenient Amenities
Guests can enjoy a range of amenities at The Manhattan at Times Square, including a fitness centre, a business centre with fax and photocopying services, and attentive concierge services.

Book your stay at The Manhattan at Times Square to experience the best of New York City right at your doorstep.
data.hotelImportantInformation:
Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.
In response to Coronavirus (COVID-19), additional safety and sanitation measures are in effect at this property.
Please inform The Manhattan at Times Square in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.
A damage deposit of USD 50 is required on arrival. This will be collected by credit card. You should be reimbursed on check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full via credit card, subject to an inspection of the property.
Please note that the Manhattan at Times Square Hotel has a mandatory Facilities Fee of $43.61 per room per night provides guests with the following inclusive services, amenities and added value offerings:

All local, long distance and international phone calls
Premium high-speed wireless internet access for unlimited devices
An eco-friendly, collapsible 16 oz. water bottle to use at the hotel’s water filtration stations
Unlimited use of our Business Center
Unlimited use of our 24/7 Fitness Center with treadmills, bikes, elliptical machines and free weights
25% discount on hop on/hop off bus tour with provided QR code
*The Facilities Fee does not include service gratuity

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Mixed reviews on cleanliness with some guests praising clean rooms while others mentioned mold and dirty curtains.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Guests had mixed experiences with service, with some finding staff friendly and helpful, while others complained about slow responses and insistent tipping.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: The hotel's location was consistently praised for being close to key landmarks and attractions, despite noise complaints.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms received mixed reviews, with some guests mentioning outdated facilities, dirty curtains, and malfunctioning air conditioning.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: While some guests appreciated the location and room size, others mentioned the lack of essential amenities like a microwave and fridge.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Several guests felt that the hotel did not offer value for money due to outdated facilities, poor room conditions, and disappointments during the stay.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast and restaurant services received positive feedback overall, although some guests desired more variety.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: The overall guest experience was polarized, with some having positive experiences while others expressed major disappointments with the hotel's condition.
